end_time.description: End time for extraction. Formats: Unix timestamp (float), relative (+N) from start, or ymdhmsu. Empty uses default (10 years after start).

input_files.description: List of input pcap file paths to slice or merge. Must contain at least one file.

keep_duplicates.description: If true, do not discard duplicate packets when merging multiple files (-D).

output_file.description: Path to the output pcap file. If omitted or empty, defaults to stdout (not recommended for automation).

relative_merge.description: If true, merge files based on relative time offsets rather than absolute timestamps (-l).

session_expire_seconds.description: Seconds of inactivity after which an identified session expires. Only effective with session tracking (-e).

session_types.description: Comma-separated list of session types to track: tcp, sip, h323. Empty disables session tracking (-s).

start_time.description: Start time for extraction. Formats: Unix timestamp (float), relative (+N), or ymdhmsu (e.g., 2023y01m01d00h00m00s). Empty uses default (earliest packet).

verbosity.description: Verbosity level: 0 (silent), 1 (show session openings/closings), 2 (also show subsessions) (-v).
